title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)
_about: Most Wanted 1.3 with the quality-of-life mods: the DRM-free exe with the frame-limiter and
large-address-aware patches, the ASI loader, XtendedInput (DualSense, PlayStation prompts), the
Widescreen Fix (motion blur off), HUD Adapter, DSOAL (EAX audio) and the console keyboard.
Every file is pinned by SHA-256 and taken from mods-cache/<sha256>[.ext]; the edited files are

widescreenfix.name: Most Wanted Widescreen Fix, build of 2026-09-12 (ThirteenAG)

dsoal.name: DSOAL r648 (kcat): DSOAL_r648.zip, from inside DSOAL.zip on github.com/kcat/dsoal/releases/tag/r648 (nfs-blackbox-ps5: mods/dsoal/DSOAL.zip)

console-keyboard.name: NFSMWConsoleKeyboard.asi, built from mods/NFSMWConsoleKeyboard by tools/build-asis.sh (nfs-blackbox-ps5: profiles/nfsmw/built/)

upgrade-1.2.name: Most Wanted 1.2 to 1.3 diff (nfs-blackbox-ps5: profiles/nfsmw/nfsmw-1.2-to-1.3.zip): put it in mods-cache by hand

# NFS Most Wanted — DXVK 3.1.1
# The 360 pack rewrites dynamic buffers the GPU may still be reading; cached
# CPU-side copies keep those locks from waiting on the GPU.
d3d9.cachedDynamicBuffers = True

# prospero-win: the PS5 port takes 48 kHz stereo; a deeper buffer than the default 3 x 1024 for the console's coarser thread wake-ups.
[general]
channels = stereo
frequency = 48000
period_size = 1024
periods = 4
hrtf = false
